run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T22:02:47Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is explained by the frontend's own error spans on the /api/data path, whose failing child call is grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds. The ad service stopped serving: its oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span rate fell from ~1.01/s at 22:01:05 to 0 by 22:07:05 and ad produced no spans at all in 22:09:47-22:19:47, while its single pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 repeatedly terminated OOMKilled (exit 137), reached restartCount 4, went Ready=False at 22:05:04 and emitted 23 BackOff events between 22:02:01 and 22:09:40. The fault-injection objects observable in events are Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (namespace chaos-mesh), which spawned StressChaos experiments every ~1 minute from 22:00:52, each reporting 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' and recovering ~55s later; the ad container's memory limit is 450Mi and its working set was ~354MB before the first kill. The exact causal step from injected memory stress to the OOMKill is a hypothesis: the Schedule and StressChaos custom resources are not readable with the permitted kinds, Jaeger has no traces after 21:53:03, and frontend container logs returned no lines. The flagd flags adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc were 'off' when read, so flag-driven ad failure was not the mechanism seen.

claims.text: Frontend error-span rate (sum by status_code, rate over 5m of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend"}) was exactly 0 at every sampled point from 21:39:05 through 22:01:05, then 1.359/s at 22:03:05, 3.011/s at 22:05:05, peaked 4.489/s at 22:13:05 and was 0.895/s at 22:15:05; frontend total span rate (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) fell from ~51/s at 22:11:05 to 17.2/s at 22:15:05.

Within 21:58:47-22:19:47 the frontend's error spans are concentrated on one path: GET 560.48, executing api route (pages) /api/data 560.48, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 560.48 and GET /api/data 560.48 span increases, plus tcp.connect 19.58; the next entries (grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, /api/cart, /api/checkout routes) are 0.

At 22:19:47 the 10-minute rates were frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0.355/s, frontend STATUS_CODE_UNSET 6.83/s, frontend-proxy STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0.169/s, and ad STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 and STATUS_CODE_UNSET 0, so the frontend error rate was still non-zero at the newest available sample while the ad service emitted no spans.

The ad service's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span rate fell from 1.011/s at 22:01:05 to 0.715/s at 22:03:05, 0.270/s at 22:05:05 and 0 from 22:07:05 through 22:15:05, while its flagd.evaluation.v1.Service spans continued at background levels (~0.0037/s) as they had since 21:51:05.
The increase of traces_span_metrics_calls_total for service ad, span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds was 0 over the 600s ending 22:19:47, i.e. ad served no GetAds spans in that window.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (namespace otel-demo) has container ad in state terminated with reason OOMKilled and exitCode 137, finishedAt 22:05:03Z, lastState terminated OOMKilled exitCode 137 finishedAt 22:04:01Z startedAt 22:03:31Z, restartCount 4, ready=false; the pod's Ready and ContainersReady conditions are False with reason ContainersNotReady since 22:05:04Z ('containers with unready status: [ad]').

Events for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 show 23 BackOff events ('Back-off restarting failed container ad in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5_otel-demo') from 22:02:01Z to 22:09:40Z, and 6 Started container ad / Created container ad events between 21:24:26Z and 22:06:32Z.

StressChaos events in namespace chaos-mesh record memory-stress experiments applied to exactly otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad: otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq Applied 22:00:52Z, otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-7n9mk Applied 22:01:52Z, -8b272 Applied 22:02:52Z, -sh425 Applied 22:03:52Z, -w8tqb Applied 22:04:53Z and -w98sl Applied 22:07:42Z, each followed about 55s later by 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos'; -w4ct8 (22:05:52Z) and -9ncrx (22:08:37Z) logged Warning 'Failed to apply chaos: ... no running task found'.

Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh is the object that created those experiments: Spawned events ('Create new object: otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-<suffix>') at 22:00:52Z, 22:01:52Z, 22:02:52Z, 22:03:52Z, 22:04:52Z, 22:05:52Z, 22:07:42Z and 22:08:37Z, plus Forbid events 'Forbid spawning new job because: ... is still running' at 22:06:52Z, 22:07:52Z, 22:08:52Z and 22:09:05Z.
Deployment ad in otel-demo runs 1 replica with container ad image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and resources limits memory 450Mi / cpu 50m, requests memory 225Mi / cpu 10m.

container_memory_working_set_bytes for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 container ad was 349.4 MiB at 21:50:05Z and rose slowly to 354.6 MiB by 22:05:35Z, then dropped to 175.3 MiB / 117.9 MiB / 180.4 MiB at later samples (container restarts); the pod-level series without a container label reached 449.8 MiB at 22:11:05Z.

Pod inventory in otel-demo shows ad-554b849958-l9ft5 Running with restartCount 4 and ready=false, whereas frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is Running with restartCount 0 and ready=true and the other listed pods (accounting, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) are ready with 0 restarts.

The ad container's readable log contains only normal request handling ('no baggage found in context', 'Targeted ad request received for [accessories|assembly|travel|telescopes|books|binoculars]', 'Non-targeted ad request received, preparing random response.') up to its newest line at 22:00:52.132Z, with no error/exception lines; the previous container instance's log was not available.

ConfigMap flagd-config in otel-demo holds flags whose ad-related entries all have defaultVariant 'off' as read at query time (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc), as do cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure.
frontend-proxy's own error spans in the 600s ending 22:19:47 are on operations ingress (51.35 increase) and 'router frontend egress' (50.10 increase), i.e. the proxy's ingress-to-frontend hops.

In the same 21:20:05-22:20:05 period the ad error rate stayed at background ~0.0037/s (its flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream spans) while frontend and frontend-proxy error rates were 0 until 22:01:05 and then rose together (frontend 0.522/s at 22:03:05, frontend-proxy 0.259/s at 22:03:05, peaks 4.489/s and 2.244/s at 22:13:05).

The frontend trace sample returned by Jaeger for 21:30:00-22:20:05 contains traces only up to 21:53:03.7Z (source_end_at) with no error spans (all shown spans http.status_code 200 or rpc.grpc.status_code 0), so no failing-trace detail exists in this sample for the 22:02+ incident window.

The memory stress that StressChaos otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-* applied to the ad container of pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (450Mi limit) pushed that container over its memory limit, producing the repeated OOMKilled (exit 137) terminations, the 23 BackOff events and the container remaining unready; with ad no longer answering, the frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans on /api/data errored, which is what drove the frontend RequestErrorRate alert. The direct step from stress to OOM is inferred, not observed: the largest sampled pod-level working set was 449.8MiB at 22:11:05Z and the container samples were 30s apart.

frontend-proxy's error spans on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' are downstream of the frontend's failing /api/data responses (frontend returns errors to the proxy), based on the identical onset window and the fact that its only error operations are the proxy hops in front of the frontend; the trace-level status propagation was not observable because Jaeger holds no traces after 21:53:03.

A failing frontend workload is not the cause: frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is Running, ready=true and restartCount 0 in the cluster snapshot, while the unavailable dependency (ad) and the failing client call (grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds) are visible in the frontend's own error spans.

A flagd feature-flag fault against the ad service is not supported by the evidence read: flagd-config's adFailure, adHighCpu and adManualGc all had defaultVariant 'off' when read, and the ad service's own error spans were limited to its long-standing flagd EventStream background (~0.0037/s) rather than GetAds failures; the flag values are only known at query time, not at 22:02.

gaps: The Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and its StressChaos children are custom resources that the permitted Kubernetes kinds cannot read, so their spec (stress size, selector, duration, schedule interval) and current phase are unread; only their events were readable.
Whether the Schedule kept spawning memory-stress experiments after 22:09:40Z is unknown: the events source ends at 22:09:40Z and no later Schedule/StressChaos object could be read.

Jaeger returned no traces for frontend after 21:53:03.7Z, so the failing spans' error details (status codes, error messages) and the parent-child propagation inside the frontend traces during 22:02-22:20 are unknown.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx returned 0 lines (0 bytes), so no frontend application-log evidence was available; the ad container's previous-instance log was also unavailable.

kube-state-metrics series such as kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready returned no data (get_metric_names and get_series for kube_deployment*/kube_pod_status* matched nothing), so deployment readiness history could not be checked.

Whether the ad container's memory actually exceeded its 450Mi limit is not directly observed: container_memory_working_set_bytes samples are 30s apart, the maximum container-labelled sample seen was 354.6MiB and only an unlabelled pod-level series reached 449.8MiB at 22:11:05Z.
Error-rate series for checkout, cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email were not returned by the query over 21:20:05-22:20:05; their error state is unknown, not zero.
State and impact after the newest available samples (metrics to about 22:19:47Z, pod objects at about 22:21Z) are unknown; the alert's later resolution cannot be assessed.
next_steps: Inspect the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and its StressChaos children (spec.stress memory size, mode/selector, duration, schedule) through a chaos-mesh-aware client with read permission for those CRDs, and confirm whether the schedule is still active.

If the memory stress is unintended, suspend/disable the Schedule and then verify that ad-554b849958-l9ft5 becomes ready with restartCount stable and that oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span rate returns to ~1/s.
Review the ad container memory limit (450Mi, request 225Mi) against its ~354MiB baseline working set, since the headroom is small for any memory pressure.
Re-check Jaeger/agent configuration so traces exist past 21:53:03, and enable frontend container log capture, to allow span-level confirmation of the AdService error status on the /api/data path.
